"""Week 2 (day 14) actions."""
import novamind_api as nm

# 1) Fix satisfaction: bump ops to resolve issues faster + raise quota A to kill cap complaints
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=700, development=1500)   # global ops up 300->700; global dev unchanged 1500
nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=3000, B=6000, C=20000)             # A 1500->3000 (double); kill cap complaints

# 2) Hold quality investment (build the asset; S1 conversion ROI proven, S2 is the unlock bet)
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 1000, "S2": 1500})

# 3) Consolidate ALL ad spend into content_marketing (cheapest leads; conversion is channel-independent)
#    Scale S1 (proven 16% converter + reputation hub) modestly; bigger S2 probe sample.
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 850, "S2": 150}
})

# 4) Keep lead promo $5 global (lowers price S1 sees -> easier to clear quality-price bar)
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5.0)

# 5) Social post: address the top complaints (caps + support) -- aligned w/ real fixes. Should resonate w/ S1.
nm.marketing.post_social_media(content="We hear you 💙 Heavy users: we just DOUBLED usage limits, and we're investing big in faster support so nobody gets ghosted. NovaMind is built WITH you, and more improvements ship every week. 🚀")

print("Week 2 actions applied.")
print("Ops 700, Dev global 1500 + S1 1000 + S2 1500 = 4000/day; QuotaA=3000")
print("Ads: content_marketing S1=850 S2=150 (dropped social/search S1)")
